description: Read live, on-chain balances for any Solana pubkey directly from the RPC: the native SOL balance plus every non-zero SPL token position (classic SPL and Token-2022), each with mint, raw amount, ui_amount, decimals, and which token program owns it. This is the raw on-chain truth (no USD pricing) — use it to confirm the agent’s own signing wallet before a send_transfer, or to check any address. No session required. Read-only.

address.description: Base58 Solana pubkey to read balances for.

include_tokens.description: Include SPL/Token-2022 positions (default true). Set false for just the SOL balance.

name: get_wallet_balances
title: Live on-chain balances for a Solana wallet
